title: Jim Harbaugh not happy with reporter for "more insult than question" about Justin Herbert

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jim Harbaugh not happy with reporter for "more insult than question" about Justin Herbert
sources.description: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh was not happy with a reporter's line of questioning about quarterback Justin Herbert and the Chargers' inability to build a successful offense around him amid the team's 0-4 start.
